t: Energy-dense lithium coin batteries with leak-proof construction. Optimised for use with devices such as car keys, remote controls, smart watches, blood glucose monitors, smart home devices, IoT devices, and door and window sensors. Offers reliable performance from -20 to +60°C, with a shelf life of up to 10 years when properly stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Delivers up to 30% more power compared with batteries of the same type in IEC standard test (results may vary by devices and usage pattern).
